item.text:
Moved the dashboard fetch behind a page-level Suspense boundary. With the existing `cacheComponents: true` setting, Next.js can prerender the page heading and dashboard skeleton while the request is pending.

Added a shared, layout-matched skeleton for both the prerendered fallback and route loading state in [DashboardSkeleton.tsx](/workspace/app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx). The existing API returns all dashboard data together, so the stats, chart, and invoices still appear as one streamed section.

I left the unrelated `package.json` and `package-lock.json` changes untouched. I did not run tests or a build.
